cover: Use case: stylized-concept. A sleek editorial vector cover for a technical article, wide landscape 2.4:1. Deep charcoal background, warm-white title and a single vivid orange accent. Left large exact headline in beautifully spaced modern sans-serif: 'Before scoring a model, test the evaluator'. Small uppercase kicker 'AI EVALS'. Right a large simple rubber grading-stamp silhouette, its base visibly chipped and misaligned. A single oversized orange magnifying glass focuses on the defective base of the stamp itself. Beneath it one clean blank answer sheet is partly visible but outside the magnifier's focus. The point is to inspect the tool doing the grading, not just inspect the submitted answer. Strong minimal silhouettes and clean geometric detail, legible focal point at thumbnail size, no text on the stamp or paper. No computer, brain, robot, circuitry, ruler, arithmetic, plotted data, charts, gradients, paper texture, 3D, logo or watermark. Thoughtful magazine art direction with safe crop margins and generous negative space.
